subject: barney
label: barney, in the place of the game's models/barney.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hassassin.mdl, models/scientist.mdl, models/zombie.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, D, B where the asset was A, C, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Stocky and roughly the right build, and the head, vest and legs read as a man. But the torso is a near-box, the arms are stubby and merge into the vest, and the helmet is a flat-topped dark block, so the outline is looser than a close look wants. Seen in sides.png, front, left and back.

M2.reason: Measured 26 x 30 x 76.7 against the brief's 75 high (2.3% off). Within 15%.

M3.reason: Small parts asked for: helmet visor, SECURITY lettering on the vest back, pistol holster, belt, vest. The helmet has no visor, neither as shape nor as paint, in front or front-left (sides.png). The back view of the vest shows no SECURITY lettering, so it is missing at this size. The holster (black block on the right hip, sides.png right and back-right) and the belt are there. A part missing caps M3 at 1.

M4.reason: Blue shirt, black vest, pale skin and black boots match the brief. The trousers are grey-white striped, not the blue-violet the brief asks for, across all views in sides.png and motion.png. That region is there but clearly off.

M5.reason: The one marking the brief names, SECURITY on the back of the vest, is absent in the back and back-left/back-right views. The trousers carry a horizontal grey stripe texture that reads as cloth, but the named lettering is not there.

M6.reason: Measured by the line-up: three judges picked the Valve originals (D, D, B) where the asset stood at A, C, C, so the asset was not picked as the odd one out. Capped at 2 here.

M7.reason: Upright, face and vest front to the viewer, and the feet sit on the floor line at the origin in every side view (sides.png, motion.png).

M8.reason: SMAK checks pass with no errors. 658 triangles is within twice the Half-Life median for its kind (504, so the ceiling is 1008) and well under the most Valve spends on a kind of this size. Nothing reported as open or floating.

C1.reason: Run (motion.png) and attack (attack.png): the body, vest and head stay together and the legs swing. The attack's forward arm reads as a loose pale hand at chest height with no pistol in it, so the action is hard to read. The picture is small, so this is a marked-down reading, not a clear fault.
